tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅ // tshogs mchod byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs so//

bde chen zhing gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir gnam chos bde chen zhing sgrub kyi sgo nas tshogs mchod bya bar 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor bshams la/ bdag nyid sems dpa'i thugs ka nas// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros bsregs gtor bkrus// ma dag tshogs rnams kun sbyangs nas// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyur// oṃ āḥhūṃ/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ gnas 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas// chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen gnas 'dir byon// gnas nub phyogs bde chen zhing khams nas// bcom ldan 'od dpag med mgon gnas 'dir byon// gnas ri bo ta la'i zhing khams nas// 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang gnas 'dir byon// gnas lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas// gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje gnas 'dir byon// gnas phyir mi ldog pa'i zhing khams nas// byang sems nyan thos dgra bcom gnas 'dir byon// gnas lho nub dpal ri'i pho brang nas// rje padma 'byung gnas gnas 'dir byon// gnas chos nyid bde chen klong yangs nas// sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje gnas 'dir byon// gnas zab zhi spros bral pho brang nas// grub thob karma chags med gnas 'dir byon// gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng nas// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma gnas 'dir byon// gnas mkha' spyod dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// yi dam rdo rje phag mo gnas 'dir byon// gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs gnas 'dir byon// gnas bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral gnas 'dir byon// gnas nye ba'i 'thung spyod pho brang nas// bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum gnas 'dir byon// byin rlabs dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// 'dir tshogs kyi rnal 'byor dam tshig gtsang*// 'dod yon gyi tshogs mchod dang re spro// spro dga' dang ldan pa'i mchod pa 'bul//

tshogs dang po 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong la// ga ṇa tsakra'i mchod pa 'bul// dgyes par bzhes la bdag cag la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// tshogs bar pa bskang bshags bya ba ni/ bskang rdzas mchod pa'i dngos po rnams// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsregs gtor bkrus// dngos 'dzin ma dag kun sbyangs nas// ye shes mchog gi bdud rtsir gyur// hūm̐ spros bral kun bzang klong yangs su// 'gyur med rang rtsal 'phro 'du las// sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho// dpag med nam mkha'i mtha' klas pas// bde chen zhing gi mgon po mchog /snang ba mtha' yas thugs dam bskang*// snying rje'i dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon// byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs// rdo rje 'dzin rgyal mthu chen thob// sems dpa' rnam gnyis thugs dam bskang*// yab yum sras dang btsun mor bcas// sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med tshogs// nyan thos rang rgyal dgra bcom pa// 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// bdud mgon nag po seṅge'i gdong*// yum chen si nā ra ma dang*// las mkhan bam ro pho mo sogs// bka' sdod rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam gnyan po dgyes bskangs nas// bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyis// tshe dpal ye shes rgyas pa dang*// nad gdon nyer 'tshe zhi bar mdzod// bskang bya skong byed bskang yul rnams// gnyis su med pa'i klong du bskang*// bshags pa ni/ hoḥ bdag cag ma rig rmongs pa yis// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig las// 'gal zhing nyams chags gyur pa kun// mi 'chab mi sbed mthol zhing bshags// dag tshang mchog gis dbugs dbyung nas// mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// bshags bya bshags byed yul las 'das// rten 'brel tsam du bshags par bgyi// oṃ badzra satwa sogs kyis brgya brjod/ rjes su mched lcam rnams kyi mar me thogs/ smon lam 'di mgrin gcig tu btab bo//

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bde chen bde ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa 'di// bdag sogs sngon smon bzang pos las 'brel ba'i// rdo rje mched lcam 'dir tshogs thams cad kyis// dngos 'byor mchod sprin bzang po legs bshams shing*// lhag bsam mos blos rgya cher spel byas nas// bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rab bsags ste// gzhan don theg chen smon lam mtshams sbyar nas// legs byas 'di mthus ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus// bar do'i 'khrul snang bsam 'das mthong ba'i tshe// dbyings rig 'od gsal ma bu ngo 'phrod nas// dngangs skrag 'jigs pa bral ba'i 'od lam la// bcom ldan 'od dpag med kyis mdun nas bsus// byang sems 'khor tshogs rgya mtshos rgyab nas skyor// 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i g.yang sa las grol nas// bde chen padmo bkod pa'i zhing khams su// padma'i snying por 'khrungs shing sangs rgyas mjal// dam pa'i chos thob sa lam mthar phyin nas// rdzogs sangs rgyas thob mkha' mnyam sems can kun// ring min bde nas bde bar 'god nus pa'i// ded dpon chen por bdag nyid 'gyur bar shog /shes rab ye shes gsal ba'i sgron me 'dis// las nyon sgrib gnyis mun pa rab gsal zhing*// yang dag lam gyi snang ba cher rgyas nas// gtan bde'i rgyal sar 'god pa'i sgron mer shog / ces smon lam btab nas mar me rnams mchod yul gyi mdun du 'bul bar bya'o// las kyi rdo rjes thabs shes kyi rdzas lag tu thogs te/ kyai/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom bya mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// mched lcam rnams kyi mgrin gcig tu/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'dod chags dri ma dang bral ba// gzung dang 'dzin pa kun spangs pa'i// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// tshogs la rol/ ༈ lhag ma bran la/ lhag la dbang ba dregs pa'i tshogs// lhag gtor 'di longs phrin las mdzod// mi mthun gnod pa'i tshogs kun bzlog

/bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces lhag gtor bskyal/ chad mdo ni/ hūm̐/ snang srid lha srin ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// sngon gyis dam bca' gnyan las ma 'da' bar// dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// brtan skyongs ni/ bhyo/ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma chen mo rnams// 'dir gshegs bka' yi gtor ma'i bshal chu bzhes// bod khams bde zhing lo legs srid rnams 'phel// chos 'di dar rgyas mthong thos smin grol mdzod// gtor bro ni/ hūm̐/ skye 'gags gnyis su med pa'i klong*// ye shes chen po'i bro brdung pas// gnyis 'dzin dgra bgegs rang sar dag /chos kyi dbyings su rnam par rgyal// bkra shis smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// zhes tshogs mchod nyung ngu 'di bzhin dgos zhes lha bris pa karma chos 'byor nas yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ 7karma pa bcu bzhi pas 'og min mtshur phu'i gdan sa chen por sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig// /
